relationships.status: Implemented and repository-tested in TIDAS Tools v0.2.0
relationships.evidence: The public CLI contract and conversion tests implement TIDAS package projection to XSD-valid eILCD XML with deterministic envelope and semantic-recovery sidecars.
relationships.constraints: TIDAS-only fields require sidecars for verified reverse recovery; standalone XML is a projection, not full native-field equivalence.
relationships.validation_question: Independently reproduce semantic and numerical round trips with and without sidecars on public packages.

relationships.status: Implemented and repository-tested in TIDAS Tools v0.2.0
relationships.evidence: The public CLI contract, report schema and tests implement explicit ILCD/eILCD input conversion to validated TIDAS packages.
relationships.constraints: Sidecar-assisted recovery applies to outputs from the paired forward conversion; arbitrary third-party eILCD packages may expose different constructs.
relationships.validation_question: Test independently produced public eILCD packages and publish dataset-type coverage and exceptions.
